_comment: Generic clinical findings we deliberately do NOT give a condition bucket -- the condition analogue of data/ignored_analytes.json. A printed diagnosis that matches one of these terms (whole-word token containment, same as the buckets) is dropped from the review queue instead of nagging forever. Committed and GENERIC ONLY: put a clinical term here (e.g. 'cholelithiasis', 'flat foot'), never a person's record-specific or garbled string -- those get FIXED against the PDF (tools/conditions_review.py) until they reduce to a generic term. Curated via the review worksheet.
